faq.title: Common questions before starting.
faq.text: Short and concrete, so it is easier to decide on the first conversation.

items.q: Are the websites available in three languages from the beginning?
items.a: Yes. Polish is the default language, while Ukrainian and English are prepared in the same translation structure.

items.q: Can I order only a website without SEO and NFC?
items.a: Yes. Websites are the main OneTouch service, while SEO and NFC can be added when they make sense for the business.

items.q: Do you work with small local companies?
items.a: Yes. The offer structure is built especially for small and medium businesses in Poland.

items.q: Is WhatsApp enough for the first contact?
items.a: Yes. A short message with your industry, location and website goal is enough to define the next step.

contact.title: Tell us how customers should find your business.
contact.text: Write a few sentences about the company, offer and website goal. You can start with WhatsApp or send a message through the form.
